name: Delaware
overview: A statewide senior credit offsets part of regular school property taxes on a principal residence.

programs.name: Senior School Property Tax Credit
programs.incomeDefinition: Not income-tested under the statewide program.
programs.incomeLimits: No income limit listed for the statewide credit.
programs.maximumBenefit: 50% of regular school property tax, up to $500.
programs.formulaSummary: Lesser of half the qualifying school levy or $500, deducted from bill.
programs.application: Apply to county by April 30; annual reapplication generally unnecessary.
eligibilityNotes: Residency waiting periods depend on when Delaware domicile began; newer arrivals generally require ten consecutive years.
Prior-year property taxes must have been paid in full.
interactions: County exemptions and disabled-veteran relief require separate review.

researchNotes: A legislative fiscal note proposing a higher cap is not evidence of enactment; the agency overview states $500.
